control_1: measure_checkpoint of A/seed<s>/ckpt-003000.pt vs runs/fresh-stream/ledger.json A.ckpt3000.* statistic keys
decision_rule: A failed control or a measurement that raised makes the result inconclusive (exit 3). The primary checkpoint P is the largest listed checkpoint measured on every seed before the deadline; if P < 6000 the result is inconclusive. ESCAPES if R(P) holds on every seed; STIRRING if R(P) fails but at least one seed's stream answer loss has a 100-step window below 2.6726 at or before P; NO_ESCAPE otherwise, reported as NO_ESCAPE by P.
expected: NO_ESCAPE by 9000 (about 60 %). If anything moves, it is one seed, late, reading as STIRRING (about 30 %). ESCAPES about 10 %. The basis is the flat 2.78 plateau from step 500 to 3000 and the very slow creep.
question: Does a fresh-start TG model escape the chance plateau on a non-repeating stream if it is simply trained longer? Continue fresh-stream arm A from its ckpt 3000 to ckpt 9000 on the same stream.

reading.ESCAPES: a fresh start learns memory-mediated retrieval with enough steps; memorisation speeds it up rather than being required
reading.NO_ESCAPE: no sign of learning in P steps of a non-repeating stream
reading.STIRRING: learning has begun on at least one seed but has not reached R by P
